as_told.title: Kettle 1 footage censored with a white triangle at the 1998 declassification

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels relays a claim from a man named Jeff Kushank about film of Bluegill Triple Prime, a 1962 US nuclear test at Johnston Atoll, a remote island. Kushank says the film showed a UFO and was later censored by laying a white triangle over the spot where it appeared, which would mean the government hid a UFO at a nuclear test. In a later episode Michels tells it a bit differently, naming the footage Kettle 1 and saying the triangle was added in 1998, when the film was cleared for public release, by the Defense Special Weapons Agency, a Pentagon nuclear weapons agency, then led by Byron Ristvet.
